title: Masseter, temporalis and the jaw line

queue.claim: Bunkyo Health Study (older Japanese adults, MRI): masseter volume is about 35 mL in men and 25 mL in women (from a search summary; whether per side is unknown).

queue.claim: Botulinum toxin and bone: a CBCT study (n=20) reports bone-volume loss at the mandibular angle after repeated injections, while a 12-month placebo-controlled CT trial (150 vs 37) found no change in bigonial width, gonial angle or cortical thickness. Soft-tissue bulk falls about 25-30%, with recovery reported at about 6 months versus 6-12 months.
